summary.name: remio
summary.one_liner: remio is a personal AI assistant and knowledge hub that captures web pages, meetings, emails and files into a searchable, local-first knowledge base and answers questions from it with source citations.
use_cases: Searching across past research, files and browsing history
Drafting Word, Excel or PowerPoint deliverables from existing materials
Building literature reviews from papers and videos
Organizing and recalling web content automatically
summary.what_it_does: remio continuously collects content from local files, web browsing, meetings and emails, and indexes it on the device. Users can ask questions in chat and receive answers with citations to the original sources. It can record online meetings without a bot, import audio, video or podcast links for transcription, and ask questions across multiple meetings. It also generates native Word, Excel and PowerPoint files and offers built-in viewers and editors, with access to multiple AI models and connectors such as Google Drive, Gmail, Slack and GitHub.
notable: Local-first: indexing, search, recording and transcription stay on the device, with optional cloud or local models
Automatic web page capture while browsing, with AI summaries in-app and in the browser extension
Meeting recording without inviting a bot, with transcription tailored to the user's terms
Listed in awesome-mac under AI Tools, described as a freeware local-first AI chat client
caveats: The mobile app requires the desktop app to work
Some listed features (Knowledge Blending, Smart Write) are upcoming rather than available
Pricing details are not stated on the page; the awesome-mac listing tags it as Freeware
